text: Which of the following is a type of software maintenance?
explanation: Corrective, perfective, and adaptive are all types of software maintenance.

text: What is the software development life cycle (SDLC)?
optionA: A process for developing software in a planned and structured way
explanation: SDLC is a structured process for developing software, including planning, design, implementation, and testing.

text: Which of the following is a software testing technique?
explanation: White-box, black-box, and gray-box testing are all software testing techniques.

text: What is the purpose of the agile software development model?
optionB: To deliver software in small, incremental releases
explanation: Agile methodology emphasizes delivering software in small, incremental releases and adapting to change.

text: Which of the following is a key principle of software engineering?
explanation: Simplicity, modularity, and abstraction are key principles of software engineering.

text: What is the purpose of the waterfall model?
optionA: To develop software in a linear, sequential approach
optionB: To develop software in iterative cycles
optionD: To involve the customer throughout the process
explanation: The waterfall model is a linear and sequential approach to software development.

text: Which of the following is a type of variable in programming?
explanation: Local, global, and static are different types of variables.

text: What is a pointer in programming?
optionA: A variable that stores a memory address
optionB: A variable that stores a value
optionC: A function that returns a value
explanation: A pointer is a variable that stores the memory address of another variable.

text: Which of the following is a function of the stack in program execution?
explanation: The stack is used to store local variables and function call information during program execution.

text: What is the time complexity of bubble sort in the worst case?
explanation: Bubble sort has a worst-case time complexity of O(n^2).

text: Which of the following is a graph traversal algorithm?
explanation: DFS, BFS, and Dijkstra's algorithm are all graph traversal algorithms.

text: What is the purpose of using a priority queue?
optionA: To store elements in FIFO order
optionB: To store elements in LIFO order
optionC: To store elements with associated priorities
optionD: To store elements in random order
explanation: A priority queue stores elements with associated priorities and retrieves them based on priority.

text: Which of the following is a type of malware?
explanation: Viruses, worms, and Trojan horses are all types of malware.

text: What is the purpose of a firewall in network security?
optionA: To monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic
explanation: A firewall monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on security rules.

text: Which of the following is a cryptographic technique?
explanation: Symmetric encryption, asymmetric encryption, and hashing are all cryptographic techniques.

text: What is the purpose of a digital certificate?
optionB: To verify the identity of a website
explanation: A digital certificate is used to verify the identity of a website and enable secure connections.

text: Which of the following is a type of denial-of-service (DoS) attack?
explanation: A DoS attack floods a server with requests to overwhelm it and make it unavailable.

text: What is the role of the data link layer in the OSI model?
optionA: To transmit raw bits over a physical medium
optionB: To provide error-free transmission of frames between nodes
explanation: The data link layer ensures error-free transmission of frames between two directly connected nodes.

text: Which of the following is a characteristic of a relational database?
optionB: Data is stored in hierarchical structures
optionC: Data is stored in key-value pairs
explanation: Relational databases store data in tables with rows and columns.

text: What is the purpose of an index in a database?
explanation: An index is used to improve the speed of data retrieval operations.

text: Which of the following is a DDL (Data Definition Language) command?
explanation: CREATE, ALTER, and DROP are DDL commands used to define and modify database structures.

text: What is a transaction in a database?
optionA: A single operation on the database
optionB: A sequence of operations that are performed as a single logical unit
explanation: A transaction is a sequence of operations that is treated as a single logical unit.

text: Which of the following is a type of memory management technique in operating systems?
explanation: Paging, segmentation, and virtual memory are all memory management techniques.

text: What is a process in an operating system?
optionB: A program stored on a disk
explanation: A process is a program that is currently being executed by the CPU.

text: Which of the following is a type of CPU scheduling algorithm?
explanation: Round Robin, Priority Scheduling, and Shortest Job First are all CPU scheduling algorithms.

text: What is the purpose of a semaphore in operating systems?
optionB: To control access to shared resources
explanation: A semaphore is a synchronization primitive used to control access to shared resources.

text: What is a thread in an operating system?
explanation: A thread is a lightweight process that shares resources with other threads in the same process.

text: Which of the following is a type of software testing?
explanation: Unit testing, integration testing, and system testing are all levels of software testing.

text: What is the purpose of version control systems?
optionA: To track changes to files and collaborate on projects
explanation: Version control systems track changes to files and enable collaboration among team members.

text: Which of the following is a design pattern in software engineering?
explanation: Singleton, Factory, and Observer are all common design patterns.

text: What is the purpose of a UML diagram?
optionA: To design and visualize software systems
explanation: UML (Unified Modeling Language) diagrams are used to design and visualize software systems.

text: Which of the following is a type of computer bus?
explanation: Data bus, address bus, and control bus are the three types of system buses.

text: What is the function of the memory management unit (MMU)?
optionA: To translate virtual addresses to physical addresses
explanation: The MMU translates virtual addresses to physical addresses in memory.

text: Which of the following is a characteristic of RISC architecture?
explanation: RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer) uses simple, fixed-length instructions.

text: What is the purpose of pipelining in a CPU?
explanation: Pipelining allows multiple instructions to be processed simultaneously, improving throughput.

text: Which of the following is a type of secondary storage?
explanation: Hard disk drives, solid-state drives, and CD-ROMs are all examples of secondary storage.

text: What is the purpose of an interrupt handler in an operating system?
optionC: To respond to hardware and software interrupts
explanation: An interrupt handler is a routine that processes hardware and software interrupts.
